# Rirote Global

> Rirote Global is a software company in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. It builds web platforms and SaaS products, AI agents and LLM features, ERP integrations and cloud infrastructure for businesses in India, the United States and the Middle East, and makes ERPTick, a service desk for equipment makers connected to ERPNext. Contact: info@riroteglobal.com.

## Company

- [Home](https://riroteglobal.com/): services, case studies and contact form
- [About](https://riroteglobal.com/about): who we are, how we work and ways to work with us
- [Work](https://riroteglobal.com/projects): case studies in enterprise ERP, manufacturing ERP, SaaS, logistics and e-commerce
- [Contact](https://riroteglobal.com/contact): enquiry form and email

## Services

- [All services](https://riroteglobal.com/services)
- [Websites & Web Apps](https://riroteglobal.com/services/full-stack-development): full-stack development of websites, web apps and online products
- [AI Assistants & Automation](https://riroteglobal.com/services/ai-integration): AI assistants and automations that work with your own data
- [ERP Integration](https://riroteglobal.com/services/erp-integration): connecting your ERP to other software, custom modules and dashboards
- [Hosting, Speed & Security](https://riroteglobal.com/services/cloud-devops): cloud and DevOps on AWS and DigitalOcean
- [Technical Advice & Team Leadership](https://riroteglobal.com/services/technical-leadership): architecture reviews, plans and team leadership
- [Reports & Dashboards](https://riroteglobal.com/services/data-pipelines): data pipelines, reports and management dashboards
- [Hire Dedicated Developers](https://riroteglobal.com/services/dedicated-engineers): vetted developers who join your team

## Products

- [ERPTick Service Desk](https://riroteglobal.com/products/erptick): field service desk for equipment makers on ERPNext: tickets, SLAs, field visits, AMC contracts, quotations and a customer portal
- [Roomcraftr](https://riroteglobal.com/products/roomcraftr): quotes, orders and dealer commissions for curtain and blind shops (in development)
- [stop-guessing](https://riroteglobal.com/products/stop-guessing): open-source guardrails for AI coding agents (MIT)
